What the licence does not cover, and what this repository therefore never takes: Orca's name and marks, its icons and splash art, its Firebase configuration, and the third-party agent icons in its shared folder. Two Orca assets carry their own licences (a different MIT holder for `expo-two-way-audio`; SIL OFL 1.1 for two terminal fonts); if either is ever copied, it gets its own row in `ORCA_FILES.md` and its own entry in `mobile/src/licences.json`.
